record.question: There are many anecdotes about the new secretary who is an imperious personality
record.explanation: Answer C: submissive. The task asks for an antonym. Imperious describes a domineering manner that demands obedience. “Submissive” gives the contrasting willingness to yield; proud is similar, while characterless and secretive do not express the opposite. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/imperious?topic=showing-arrogance-and-conceit. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
